01648000.name: Rock Creek at Sherrill Drive Washington, DC
01648000.datum: Local gage datum; current gage zero 148.15 ft NAVD88
01648000.horizontal_crs: WGS84 (EPSG:4326) as current monitoring page and IV JSON label; legacy NWIS site inventory labels these coordinates NAD83 (EPSG:4269)
01648000.timestamp_notes: CSV timezone absent. Fixed EST (UTC-05:00, no DST) inferred from exact NOAA Storm Events matches in 1996, 2005, 2019 and merged 2025 windows; not all 125 rows individually verified. USGS source ISO offsets preserved; NOAA gmt responses are UTC. Never relabel naive source times as UTC.
01648000.processing: Only actual numeric observations retained; no interpolation. Deduplicated on station_id and UTC instant. Event windows [begin date minus 1 day 00:00, end date plus 2 days 00:00), exclusive right bound.
01648000.retrieval_notes: USGS edge gaps are checked by a padded date-only query to avoid observed winter UTC-bound endpoint omission; all timestamps are then filtered to the original UTC window. Genuine absent records are not interpolated.
01648000.sampling_notes: Interval may change historically. Metadata nominal interval is representative; actual per-window modal intervals, gaps and counts stored separately. Edge gaps are visible from first/last observation. Data absence is not zero water level.
